about.description:
It turns out that many projects need to parse executable formats and they usually re-implement
their own parser. Moreover these parsers are usually bound to one language.
LIEF attempts to fill this void.
about.summary: A cross platform library to parse, modify and abstract ELF, PE and MachO formats.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.0.0"
  build_number: 5

recipe:
  name: lief-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/lief-project/LIEF/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 2cf412695ff739d82e129db441e5c2025f3bb4873a3d3a1d3dd4cf300b682abd
    patches:
      # Remove after a release containing https://github.com/lief-project/LIEF/pull/1375
      - patches/0001-avoid-major-minor-macro-collisions.patch

build:
  # pydantic-core skips free-threaded Python 3.14 on these QEMU targets.
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  skip:
    - is_freethreading and (aarch64 or ppc64le)

outputs:
  - package:
      name: py-lief
    build:
      script:
        file: ${{ "install-py-lief.bat" if win else "install-py-lief.sh" }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: build_platform != "win-arm64"
          then: ccache
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - if: not win
          then: pkg-config
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - pydantic >=2.13.4
            - pydantic-core >=2.46.4
            - scikit-build-core >=1.0.3
            - setuptools >=83.0.0
            - tomli >=2.4.1
      host:
        - fmt
        - nlohmann_json
        # Dynamically linked to libLIEF for now; see comment in patch section.
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblief", exact=True) }}
        - python
        - pip
        # Upstream pins build dependencies exactly; we are a bit more lenient
        # here to avoid potential solvability issues.
        - pydantic >=2.13.4
        - pydantic-core >=2.46.4
        - scikit-build-core >=1.0.3
        - setuptools >=83.0.0
        - spdlog
        - tomli >=2.4.1
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblief", exact=True) }}
        - python
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("py-lief", upper_bound="x.x") }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - python
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lief
          pip_check: false
      - requirements:
          run:
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        script:
          - python -c "import ctypes.util, lief; missing = {name for name in {s.name for s in lief.parse(lief._lief.__file__).imported_functions} - {s.name for s in lief.parse(ctypes.util.find_library('LIEF')).exported_functions} if '4LIEF' in name}; assert not missing, missing"
  - package:
      name: liblief
    build:
      script:
        - if: unix
          then:
            - bash "${RECIPE_DIR}/build.sh"
            - bash "${RECIPE_DIR}/install-liblief.sh"
        - if: win
          then:
            - call "%RECIPE_DIR%\build.bat"
            - call "%RECIPE_DIR%\install-liblief.bat"
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: build_platform != 'win-arm64'
          then: ccache
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - if: not win
          then: pkg-config
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - fmt
        - nlohmann_json
        - if: not riscv64
          then: mbedtls ==4.0.0
        - spdlog
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblief", upper_bound="x.x") }}
    tests:
      - files:
          recipe:
            - tests
        requirements:
          run:
            - ${{ compiler('c') }}
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - cmake
            - ninja
        script:
          - if: not win
            then: set -x
          - if: win
            then: echo on
          - pushd tests
          - if: not win
            then: PATH=".:${PATH}"
          - if: not win
            then: findstr() { grep "${@}"; }
          - if: not win
            then: call() { true; }
          - pushd self
          - cmake -G "Ninja" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug . || exit 1
          - ninja || exit 1
          - if: not win
            then: test-lief-self || exit 1
          - popd
          - pushd spdlog
          - cmake -G "Ninja" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release . || exit 1
          - ninja || exit 1
          - test-lief-spdlog || exit 1
          - popd
          - pushd macho
          - cmake -G "Ninja" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug . || exit 1
          - ninja || exit 1
          - if: not win
            then: test-lief-macho macOS-libpython2.7.a-getbuildinfo.o > output.txt || exit 1
          - findstr has_dynamic_symbol_command output.txt && exit 1 || call;
          - popd
          - popd

about:
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: A cross platform library to parse, modify and abstract ELF, PE and MachO formats.
  description: |
    It turns out that many projects need to parse executable formats and they usually re-implement
    their own parser. Moreover these parsers are usually bound to one language.
    LIEF attempts to fill this void.
  homepage: https://lief.quarkslab.com/
  repository: https://github.com/lief-project/LIEF

about.description:
It turns out that many projects need to parse executable formats and they usually re-implement
their own parser. Moreover these parsers are usually bound to one language.
LIEF attempts to fill this void.
about.summary: A cross platform library to parse, modify and abstract ELF, PE and MachO formats.

tests.script: python -c "import ctypes.util, lief; missing = {name for name in {s.name for s in lief.parse(lief._lief.__file__).imported_functions} - {s.name for s in lief.parse(ctypes.util.find_library('LIEF')).exported_functions} if '4LIEF' in name}; assert not missing, missing"
